known_issues: Only a trusted compiler may provide HTML. Digest equality and declared source/rights references do not authenticate content or legal approval.
At most three preloaded RGB/RGBA PNGs are resolved by exact opaque digest URI. No network, filesystem resource URL, data URI or fallback handler is admitted.

The bounded PNG grammar validates framing, CRC, dimensions, deflate length and scanline filter bytes. Actual pixel decoding occurs in the confined renderer; neither operation is a full image sanitizer or content-rights verifier.
A requested resource is not by itself proof of visible painting. The caller must separately qualify same-artifact visible use, content, tags, metadata, safety and accessibility.

Legacy rendering protocols, resource limits and network/filesystem guards are retained. Aggregate whole-job CPU/RSS/scratch/process supervision and arbitrary-descendant guarantees are not established.

The existing native structure-role subset does not admit ordinary image Figure/Div tags. Decorative background assets with explicit source metadata are the tested native-compatible fixture; arbitrary semantic figures are not activated.
No scientific interpretation, source-bound report orchestration, final publication, PDF/UA certification or frozen editorial equivalence is established by this candidate-only boundary.
Historical receipts stay bound to their original code and profile. A new profile does not retroactively qualify prior native observations.
